SysDataModelXML.SQLScript:
--取合并后的多个填报车间集 WITH CTE_DEPT AS (SELECT ITMNO ,PRQNUM ,String_agg(DEPT, '/') AS PRADEPT FROM (SELECT DISTINCT L.PRQNUM ,L.ITMNO ,H.DEPT FROM PREQAL L INNER JOIN PREQAH H ON L.DOCNUM = H.DOCNUM WHERE Isnull(L.PRQNUM, '') = '{0}') DP GROUP BY ITMNO ,PRQNUM)
SELECT S.DOCNUM + Cast(S.DOCLIN AS VARCHAR) LINKROWID ,S.DOCNUM ,S.DOCNUM pid --用于APP明细表格显示关联，不可删除 ,S.DOCLIN ,S.ITMNO ,ITM.ITMNOORI ,S.FAC ,ITM.ITMNAM ,ITM.ITMNAM1 ,ITM.ITMNAM2 ,S.ITMVER --产品版本 ,dbo.Optdes('TSICOD1', ITM.TSICOD1) TSICOD1 ,dbo.Optdes('TSICOD2', ITM.TSICOD2) TSICOD2 ,dbo.Optdes('TSICOD3', ITM.TSICOD3) TSICOD3 ,dbo.Optdes('TSICOD4', ITM.TSICOD4) TSICOD4 ,S.BPSNO ,BPS.BPSNAM ,ITM.ITMSPEC ,ITM.ITMSIZE ,CONVERT(VARCHAR, S.REQDAT, 23) REQDAT ,S.UOM --采购单位 ,Cast(S.UOMCOE AS REAL) UOMCOE --采购单位系数 ,Cast(S.QTY AS REAL) QTY --采购单位数量 ,S.STU --库存单位 ,Cast(S.QTYSTU AS REAL) QTYSTU --库存单位数量 ,S.PRQLOT ,S.PRQITMBPC ,S.PRQYCOUNT ,S.REMARK LREMARK ,S.CLOREA LCLOREA ,S.SRCTYP ,S.SRCDOC ,S.SRCLIN ,dbo.Optdes('DOCSTA', S.DOCSTA) DOCSTA ,T.PRADEPT ,S.CREUSR ,S.UPDUSR ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(16), S.[CRETIM], 21) CRETIM ,Iif(CONVERT(VARCHAR(16), S.UPDTIM, 21) = '1900-01-01 00:00', '', CONVERT(VARCHAR(16), S.UPDTIM, 21)) UPDTIM ,Iif(S.DOCSTA = '1', '', '1') LDEBFLG ,Iif(S.DOCSTA IN( '1', '2' ), '', '1') LCLBFLG ,ITM.ITMVERFLG FROM PREQUL S INNER JOIN ITM ON ITM.ITMNO = S.ITMNO INNER JOIN PREQUH H ON S.DOCNUM = H.DOCNUM LEFT JOIN BPSUP BPS ON S.BPSNO = BPS.BPSNO LEFT JOIN CTE_DEPT T ON T.ITMNO = S.ITMNO WHERE S.DOCNUM = '{0}' ORDER BY S.DOCLIN

DELETE FROM [PREQUL] WHERE DOCNUM + Cast(DOCLIN AS VARCHAR) = '#LINKROWID#'
UPDATE PREQAL SET PRQNUM = '' ,PRQQTY = QTY ,PRQQTYSTU = QTYSTU WHERE PRQNUM = '#DOCNUM#' AND ITMNO = '#ITMNO#' AND ITMVER = '#ITMVER#';
